BiblicalUsage: Sharai is named once, among the sons of Bani who had taken strange wives. The list in Ezra names him beside Machnadebai and Shashai, and his name stands in the record of those who put away their foreign wives.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in Ezra's list is a man who repented, because the sons of Bani put away the wives they should not have taken.
